evidence_baseline.authority_scope: Phase 1–6 records and artifacts predating this program

program_definition.commit_rule: Set to the exact owner-accepted commit containing the protocol, prompts, and initial state before Stage 1 starts; never infer it from the Phase evidence baseline.

revision.reason: Owner-directed pre-execution amendment from GPT-6 Deep Research wording to exact GPT-5.6 Sol Codex research-task configurations.

model_policy.ultra_semantics: Codex app-native reasoning setting; not an API reasoning.effort value.

owner_constraints: Use five independent Codex research tasks with exact model gpt-5.6-sol, one per research stage.
Use reasoning max for Stage 1, Codex app-native ultra for Stages 2–5, and max for every post-stage consolidation.
Require an immutable owner-authorized launch record and prohibit alias substitution, model substitution, or silent reasoning downgrade.
Maintain a cumulative authoritative state instead of relying on chat memory.
Run an independent state-consolidation step after each frozen stage result.
Require owner acceptance before state promotion or stage advancement.
Do not begin Phase 7, run experiments, invoke experimental models/providers, or implement architecture under this program definition.

decision_registry.decision: Use five sequential research stages with an independent task for each stage.
decision_registry.reason: Reduce context contamination and preserve bounded, auditable handoffs.

decision_registry.decision: Use a cumulative canonical research state; missing state must not be filled by guess.
decision_registry.reason: Preserve cross-stage continuity without retaining irrelevant conversational tokens.

decision_registry.decision: Update authoritative state only through a post-stage consolidation task and owner acceptance.
decision_registry.reason: Separate research production from downstream-memory promotion.

decision_registry.decision: Use exact model gpt-5.6-sol with max for Stage 1 and consolidation and Codex app-native ultra for Stages 2–5; prohibit substitution and silent downgrade.
decision_registry.reason: Owner-directed protocol amendment before any research stage was executed.
